english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when discussing something from an acoustics or sound perspective rather than specifically naming an instrument.

examples.english: Acoustically, this recording studio is very well designed.
examples.traditional: 聲學上，呢間錄音室嘅設計非常完善。
